components.name: Primary action
components.description: The current workflow’s agent handoff or exact confirmation.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height:44px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:10px 16px; border:1px solid var(--accent-hover,var(--accent)); border-radius:10px; background:var(--accent-hover,var(--accent)); color:var(--accent-fg); font:500 14px var(--font); cursor:pointer; transition:background .14s ease,border-color .14s ease,transform .1s ease; } .ds-primary:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent-hover,var(--accent)) 90%,var(--text)); border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent-hover,var(--accent)) 90%,var(--text)); } .ds-primary:active { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:default; }

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: A visible alternative for assignment, cancel, or detail actions.
components.css: .ds-secondary { min-height:44px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:10px 16px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px; background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); font:500 14px var(--font); cursor:pointer; transition:background .14s ease,border-color .14s ease,transform .1s ease; } .ds-secondary:hover { background:var(--surface-2,var(--surface)); border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 35%,var(--border)); } .ds-secondary:active { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Quiet action
components.description: Back, refresh, close, and secondary navigation remain directly visible.
components.css: .ds-quiet { min-height:44px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:8px 2px; border:0; background:transparent; color:var(--muted); font:650 14px var(--font); cursor:pointer; } .ds-quiet:hover { color:var(--text); } .ds-quiet:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Compact project position
components.description: Two scannable local/upstream lines precede the PR inventory.
components.css: .ds-position { border-block:1px solid var(--border); color:var(--text); font-family:var(--font); } .ds-position div { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; min-height:52px; } .ds-position div + div { border-top:1px solid var(--border); } .ds-position span { min-width:68px; color:var(--muted); font-size:14px; } .ds-position strong { flex:1; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; } .ds-position button { min-height:44px; padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:8px; background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); font:500 14px var(--font); } .ds-position button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; } @media(max-width:680px) { .ds-position div { gap:8px; min-height:44px; } .ds-position span { min-width:0; } .ds-position button { padding-inline:10px; } }

components.name: PR list box header
components.description: GitHub-style list header: select-all and “N open”; Assign and Take on with agent appear only once PRs are selected.
components.html: 2 selected
components.css: .ds-pr-head { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; min-height:52px; padding:4px 12px 4px 4px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:8px 8px 0 0; background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); font-family:var(--font); } .ds-pr-head label { display:grid; place-items:center; width:40px; min-height:40px; } .ds-pr-head input { width:16px; height:16px; accent-color:var(--accent); } .ds-pr-head strong { flex:1; font-size:14px; } .ds-pr-head button { min-height:36px; padding:6px 12px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:8px; background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); font:500 14px var(--font); } .ds-pr-head .ds-pr-agent { border-color:var(--accent); background:var(--accent-hover,var(--accent)); color:var(--accent-fg); } .ds-pr-head :is(button,input):focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Pull request row
components.description: GitHub-style row: checkbox, state icon, title with colored labels, “#N · author opened … · ✓ n/m · +a −d” meta, quiet assign and small purple agent action on the right.
components.html:
⑂

#1047 · contributor opened 2 days ago · ✓ 18/18 · +42 −3
components.css: .ds-pr-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:40px 20px minmax(0,1fr) auto; column-gap:6px; align-items:start; padding:8px 12px 8px 4px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-top:0; color:var(--text); font-family:var(--font); } .ds-pr-row label { display:grid; place-items:center; width:40px; min-height:40px; } .ds-pr-row input { width:16px; height:16px; accent-color:var(--accent); } .ds-pr-state { padding-top:11px; color:var(--green); } .ds-pr-open { display:block; padding:7px 0 0; border:0; background:none; color:var(--text); text-align:left; line-height:1.5; } .ds-pr-open strong { font:600 16px var(--font); } .ds-label { margin-left:4px; padding:0 8px; border-radius:2em; background:var(--bg); color:var(--fg); font:500 14px/20px var(--font); } .ds-pr-row p { margin:2px 0 0; color:var(--muted); font-size:14px; } .ds-pr-row b { color:var(--green); } .ds-pr-row em { color:var(--danger); font-style:normal; } .ds-pr-row aside { display:flex; gap:2px; } .ds-pr-row aside button { width:40px; height:40px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:none; color:var(--muted); } .ds-pr-row .ds-pr-agent { background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-fg); } .ds-pr-row :is(button,input):focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Inline review confirmation
components.description: Private review or scoped repair-and-merge, model/effort at launch, review-only autopilot inside its choice.
components.html:
Review selected PRs

Choose what the agent may do. Selection alone authorizes nothing.
components.css: .ds-confirm { padding:18px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:12px; background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); font-family:var(--font); } .ds-confirm h3 { margin:0 0 8px; font-size:18px; } .ds-confirm p { font-size:16px; line-height:1.5; } .ds-confirm > div { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:10px; margin:16px 0; } .ds-confirm button { min-height:44px; padding:10px 12px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:9px; background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); font:500 14px var(--font); } .ds-confirm button[aria-pressed=true] { border-color:var(--accent); background:var(--accent-dim); } .ds-confirm summary { min-height:44px; cursor:pointer; font-size:14px; } .ds-confirm .ds-confirm-primary { margin-top:16px; border-color:var(--accent); background:var(--accent-hover,var(--accent)); color:var(--accent-fg); } .ds-confirm :is(button,summary):focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Contribution detail tabs
components.description: GitHub PR page tabs (Conversation, Files changed with count and +/−, Checks with ✓ n/m) above a bounded scroll body.

components.css: .ds-detail { color:var(--text); font-family:var(--font); } .ds-detail nav { display:flex; flex-wrap:nowrap; gap:18px; overflow-x:auto; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); } .ds-detail button { flex:none; min-height:44px; padding:8px 10px; border:0; border-bottom:2px solid transparent; background:none; color:var(--muted); font:500 14px var(--font); } .ds-detail button[aria-pressed=true] { border-bottom-color:var(--accent); color:var(--text); } .ds-detail > div { height:clamp(280px,45dvh,520px); overflow:auto; padding:12px 3px 16px; font-size:16px; } .ds-detail button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Prompt editor
components.description: Review/Fix/Merge guidance shares one flat editor; no duplicate prompt or routine safety panel.
components.html: <section class="ds-prompt"><nav aria-label="Agent prompts"><button aria-pressed="true">Review</button><button>Fix</button><button>Merge decision</button></nav><label for="ds-prompt-text">Review instructions</label><textarea id="ds-prompt-text">Review the selected changes privately.</textarea></section>
components.css: .ds-prompt { color:var(--text); font-family:var(--font); } .ds-prompt nav { display:flex; gap:16px; overflow-x:auto; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); } .ds-prompt button { flex:none; min-width:44px; min-height:48px; padding:10px 0; border:0; border-bottom:2px solid transparent; background:none; color:var(--muted); font:500 14px var(--font); } .ds-prompt button[aria-pressed=true] { border-color:var(--accent); color:var(--text); } .ds-prompt label { display:block; margin:14px 0 6px; font-size:14px; font-weight:650; } .ds-prompt textarea { box-sizing:border-box; width:100%; min-height:270px; padding:12px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:8px; background:var(--bg); color:var(--text); font:400 16px/1.6 var(--font); resize:vertical; } .ds-prompt summary { min-height:44px; cursor:pointer; font-size:14px; } .ds-prompt :is(button,textarea,summary):focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview:
Contribute is one calm project workspace, not a separate agent dashboard or Reviews room. A compact local/upstream position keeps the prepare and pull loop visible, then the open pull-request list becomes the principal working surface. Titles, authors, labels, check counts and assignment are scannable before detail is opened. Prepared work appears above PRs only when actionable. Full merge cycles and History sit below the inventory; old work is never restarted merely by opening it.

Selection belongs to the list: native checkboxes reveal bulk actions in a GitHub-style list header. An agent handoff leads to an inline choice and exact confirmation; it is not a direct action on selection. Details open inside the row, with a reserved scrolling body below stable actions and tabs. Settings is flat: Review, Fix and Merge guidance share a tabbed editor, with account management below. Model and effort are chosen per launch. Version, consent and safety checks remain implementation contracts, not routine settings content. The Möbius shell owns theme colors, typography, and icons.
keyCharacteristics: One continuous project workspace; no persistent split pane or second review room.
Compact two-line project position and immediate PR inventory.
Separate PR selection, detail, assignment, and agent action.
Inline review-mode choice and exact confirmation before a run starts.
Stable row detail actions and tabs above a bounded, scrolling context region.
Named paused work and saved history remain reachable below current work.

rules.name: Inherited Theme
rules.body: Use shell semantic color and font variables in light and dark modes. Do not pin a purple hex, manufacture a tonal ramp, or introduce an app-owned theme.

rules.name: Written State
rules.body: Text such as “✓ 18/18”, “2 failing”, “Needs you” and “Prepared · not shared” carries meaning independently of color. Passing checks are not a review verdict.

rules.name: Readable Floor
rules.body: Never shrink workflow copy to fit the phone. Keep practical control targets at least 44px; prompt tabs are 48px tall.

rules.name: Stable Inventory
rules.body: Checkbox selection neither navigates nor opens detail, changes a filter, steals focus, or scrolls the page.

rules.name: Continuous Context
rules.body: Inline decisions and detail may focus attention, but they do not replace the project or revive paused work.

rules.name: Temporary Lift
rules.body: Elevation clarifies transient controls, not every PR row or project section.

rules.name: Purposeful Radius
rules.body: Grouping and interaction earn a radius; repeated project sections do not become decorative cards.

dos: preserve the local/upstream prepare-and-pull context above PR work.
lead with visible PR title, author, labels and actual checks; omit empty agent state.
keep selection independent from row detail and route agent action through inline confirmation.
distinguish assignment, private review, legacy merge scope, and scoped takeover.
keep detail controls stable while context loads and scrolls below them.
show paused work by name and preserve its remaining steps without automatic restart.
keep editable prompts separate from frozen run snapshots and immutable safety instructions.
identify selected PRs and explain actual public effects before approval; retain exact-version binding underneath.
donts: restore a split-pane workspace, parallel Reviews room, or bottom tray as the primary PR action.
equate passing checks with a review verdict or queued work with merged work.
start agent work merely from selecting a PR or assigning a person.
hide changed-version removal, scope drift, or ambiguous outcomes.
shrink 14px metadata, 16px body copy, or 44px controls to fit the phone.
invent fixed colors, fonts, icons, approval states, or product permissions outside the shell and implemented contract.
